paper_id: Unveiling Entity-Level Unlearning for Large Language Models_ A Comprehensive Analysis
title: Unveiling Entity-Level Unlearning for Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Analysis
motivation: 现有研究聚焦instance-level遗忘，忽略了版权保护等场景下删除整个实体的需求
problem_framing: 将实体级遗忘形式化为两阶段框架：遗忘集构建+遗忘执行
key_insight: 遗忘集的知识覆盖率和大小是关键因素，但简单扩大规模会损害模型效用
method_signature: 知识探测构建遗忘集 + 评估五种主流遗忘算法
evaluation_criteria: ROUGE/概率/准确率 + KS检验Forget Quality + Model Utility调和均值
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 现有算法挣扎于实体级遗忘，NPO-GD在构造遗忘集上表现最差(0.0875 vs 0.5253)
evidence_for_taste: simply expanding the size of the constructed forget set
entities introduced through fine-tuning are more vulnerable
destroy the general ability of the model
thinking_moves: 从版权保护等现实需求反推提出新任务定义
通过可控的伪实体注入实验精确评估遗忘效果
将遗忘集覆盖率量化为BERTScore匹配度
对比预训练vs微调知识的脆弱性差异
